dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgRemoveLiqu.title: Msg Remove Liquidity
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgRemoveLiqu.description: * Remove liquidity from a pool by burning shares and returning underlying reserves. Behavior: - Supports full exit (burning all shares, deletes pool, returns all reserves)   and partial exit (burns subset, returns proportional reserves, pool remains). - Full exit: when shares = total_supply, deletes pool, pays out full reserves. - Partial exit: computes pro-rata payout using DecCoins math, ensures reserves don't go to zero (requires full exit for last liquidity). - Burns shares from signer, sends proportional reserves from module to signer. - For partial exits: updates pool reserves, persists pool; asserts AMM invariants. Validation: - Pool must exist. - Shares must be positive integer string. - Signer must hold at least shares amount. - Partial exits cannot deplete any reserve to zero. Emits: - EventPoolLiquidityRemoved with pool_id and shares Returns: - coins returned to the caller in the amount field.

amount.description: Coins returned to the caller proportional to the burned shares.
